MOJO AI Summits

SMS Terms

Last updated July 27, 2026.

Program Description

MOJO AI Summits SMS messages are used for account and VIP registration validation. When you enter your mobile number and select Verify Phone, you consent to receive a one-time verification code from MOJO AI Summits.

Message Frequency

Message frequency is one verification text per request. Additional messages are sent only if you request another verification code.

Cost

Message and data rates may apply. Charges depend on your mobile carrier and plan.

Opt Out And Help

Reply STOP to opt out. Reply HELP for help. You can also contact hello@mojoaisummits.com for support.

Privacy

SMS opt-in data is not sold or shared with third parties for their marketing. See the MOJO AI Summits Privacy Policy for more information.
